aggressive_definition_excerpt: In total, 1254 (190 advanced) incident prostate cancer cases were found during an average 7.8 y of follow-up.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: A prospective cohort study of 28,737 Seventh-day Adventist men in the United States and Canada, of whom 6389 were of black ethnicity.
reason: The prospective cohort analyzed total incident prostate cancer and explicitly reported an advanced incident prostate cancer association for dairy intake.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Men at the 90th percentile of dairy intake (430 g/d) compared with the 10th percentile (20.2 g/d) had higher prostate cancer risk (HR: 1.27; 95% CI: 1.12, 1.43).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate is for overall incident prostate cancer. The separate advanced estimate reported in the following sentence must not be conflated with it.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: HRs of total incident prostate cancer at varying intakes of calcium variables in all participants (N = 28,737), comparing 90th with 10th percentiles of intake1
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied full-text evidence identifies this total-calcium estimate as total incident prostate cancer. The abstract does not report this specific total-calcium HR and comparison.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was no evidence of an effect of higher (905 mg/d) compared with lower (349 mg/d) intakes of nondairy calcium (HR: 1.16; 95% CI: 0.94, 1.44).
estimate_classifications.reason: This nondairy-calcium estimate is presented for prostate cancer generally, not for the separately reported advanced endpoint.

additional_estimates.comparison: 430 g/d dairy intake versus 20.2 g/d dairy intake
additional_estimates.effect_excerpt: Similar findings, comparing the same g/d intakes, were demonstrated for advanced prostate cancers (HR: 1.38; 95% CI: 1.02, 1.88), for nonadvanced cases (HR: 1.27; 95% CI: 1.11, 1.45), in black participants (HR: 1.24; 95% CI: 0.98, 1.58), and when excluding vegan participants (HR: 1.22; 95% CI: 1.03, 1.43).
additional_estimates.count_excerpt: In total, 1254 (190 advanced) incident prostate cancer cases were found during an average 7.8 y of follow-up.
